entities.summary: André Giraud Pindi Mwanza Mayala is a Congolese Catholic prelate who serves as Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Matadi, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since 23 April 2022. Before that, from 18 September 1994 until he was appointed bishop, he was a priest of the same diocese, in the Metropolitan Province of Kinshasa. He was appointed bishop on 23 April 2022 by Pope Francis. He was consecrated and installed at Matadi, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 16 July 2022. While a priest, he served as Apostolic Administrator of the Diocese of Matadi from 6 March 2021 until 23 April 2022.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Bishop of Matadi, André Giraud Pindi Mwanza has played a crucial role in shaping the Catholic Church's response to the Democratic Republic of Congo's ongoing humanitarian crisis, particularly in addressing the needs of vulnerable populations affected by conflict and poverty. His appointment marks an important milestone in the diocese's efforts to promote social justice and human development.
